اقترفتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَفْتُمْ (iqtaraftum) /iq.ta.raf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
# اُقْتُرِفْتُمْ (uqturiftum) /uq.tu.rif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَفَ (iqtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
